desc: negative: Verify dualpi2 won't mistakenly deactivate QFQ parent class during peek
pre: ip link add dummy1 type dummy && ip link set dummy1 up
ip link set dev dummy1 up || true
ip addr add 10.10.10.10/24 dev dummy1 || true
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 root handle 1: qfq
tc class add dev dummy1 parent 1: classid 1:1 qfq weight 1 maxpkt 1000
tc class add dev dummy1 parent 1: classid 1:2 qfq weight 1 maxpkt 1000
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 parent 1:1 handle 2:0 plug limit 1024
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 parent 1:2 handle 10: dualpi2 step_thresh 500ms
tc filter add dev dummy1 parent 10: protocol ip prio 1 matchall classid 10:1 action ok
tc filter add dev dummy1 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip dst 10.10.10.1/32 flowid 1:1
tc filter add dev dummy1 parent 1: protocol ip prio 2 u32 match ip dst 10.10.10.2/32 flowid 1:2
tc qdisc change dev dummy1 handle 2:0 plug release_indefinite
